title: Towards Interactive Evaluations for Interaction Harms in Human-AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Proposed longitudinal, interactive evaluations measuring cumulative shifts in user decision-making patterns (e.g., in high-stakes scenarios like hiring) after repeated exposure to subtle model biases.

Proposed multi-turn interactive evaluations tracking emergent model adaptations and disparate behavior (such as increased toxicity) when users employ different dialects, such as African American English.

Proposed dynamic evaluations across multiple dialogue turns to assess how models implicitly model users and alter behaviors, such as varying refusal rates for dangerous queries based on perceived user identity or persona.
